policy: Only entries marked implemented are release claims. partial and blocked entries require a task-specific parity gate. deferred entries are outside the active hardware support matrix and are excluded from its release gate.

capabilities.name: six_point_one_sided_focal
capabilities.validation: reconstruction_camera_rig_parity_gate (exact 6-point, distorted calibrated ray, tangent-Sampson numeric, and <6-point rejection gates)
capabilities.reason: The pinned PoseLib six-point adapter is integrated into the asymmetric known-second-camera RANSAC path. It carries CamRayWithJac calibrated rays through the public camera API, scores the calibrated side with the tangent Sampson denominator, and performs TinySolver local refinement over pose direction and log focal before rescoring RANSAC support. Deterministic distorted-camera, tangent-Sampson, non-minimal rejection, and non-coplanar refinement-accuracy gates pass.
capabilities.resolution: Keep the ray/Jacobian and refinement-accuracy gates mandatory for every PoseLib-enabled reconstruction build.

capabilities.name: global_mapper_multi_component
capabilities.reason: The compatible equivalent is now implemented: all database images are partitioned, verified-match components are mapped independently, and component reconstructions are merged.

capabilities.name: caspar_gpu_bundle_adjustment
capabilities.validation: reconstruction_caspar_parity_gate (direct generated-Caspar versus Ceres Pinhole RMS, Frame/Rig composition, merged factors, and all 11 split-intrinsic factor variants)
capabilities.reason: Generated Symforce-Caspar f32/f64 kernels are imported through the 3rdparty_caspar INTERFACE target. The backend selector executes Caspar directly for PINHOLE/SIMPLE_RADIAL BA, including fixed sensor_from_rig Frame/Rig observations and all 15 upstream pose/focal-and-extra/principal-point/point variability combinations. The split-intrinsic numeric gate covers its 11 generated factors with fixed pose and point combinations, verifies fixed groups remain unchanged, and compares reprojection error to the portable CPU-Ceres reference. Upstream Caspar itself only provides Pinhole and SimpleRadial generated factors; spherical and other camera models correctly remain on Ceres. Ceres is hard-disabled for CUDA so packages do not acquire toolkit-major-version runtime dependencies; Caspar remains the independent GPU BA backend.
prerequisites: controlled representative-scene CPU-Ceres versus Caspar runtime A/B gate
capabilities.resolution: Keep the direct RMS, split-intrinsic, and Frame/Rig consistency gates mandatory in every Caspar-enabled configuration. Report performance only from controlled CPU-Ceres versus Caspar runs; never enable Ceres CUDA.

capabilities.name: loma_lightglue
capabilities.entrypoint: core/AICore LoMa C API; feature/loma.{h,cc}; base/database float_descriptors protocol; legacy reconstruction scheduler
capabilities.validation: test_loma_detector_reference_gate; test_loma_descriptor_reference_gate; test_loma_g_token_reference_gate; test_loma_b128_e2e_reference_gate; test_loma_matcher_reference_gate; test_loma_published_model_gate (all production paths load GGUF/ggml only; development fixtures are generated from pinned ONNX)
capabilities.reason: The GGUF/ggml chain covers DaD, DeDoDe-B, DeDoDe-G, LoMa-B128, and B/R/L/G matchers without ONNX Runtime. All 22 published F32/F16/Q8_0 artifacts are cataloged with shared-cache release URLs and SHA256 digests; legacy feature extraction writes the typed float_descriptors SQLite protocol and matching uses the legacy worker pipeline. A real ten-image CUDA run completed end to end: LoMa registered 10/10 images with 9020 sparse points and 68956 track observations, versus SIFT's 10/10, 145, and 689; LoMa took 82.59 seconds versus SIFT's 1.69 seconds on that fixture. DaD, DeDoDe-B, DeDoDe-G, LoMa-B128 and B/R/L/G matcher ONNX-reference gates pass. On CUDA 11.8/RTX 3060 the strict DeDoDe-G ViT-L token fixture passes without runtime workarounds (max absolute error 1.9836426e-4, relative L2 6.7295686e-6; limits 2e-3 and 2e-4); B/R/L/G matcher P/R is 1.0 with max score errors 4.77e-7, 8.40e-6, 4.77e-7, and 5.96e-7 respectively. The repair materializes F32 SDPA and prevents direct F32 convolution from entering CUDA's TF32 IGEMM path. No ONNX Runtime is linked into ACloudViewer.
prerequisites: test_loma_g_token_reference_gate with the pinned ONNX token fixture
per-model DaD/DeDoDe and B/R/L/G matcher reference gates
capabilities.resolution: Keep the pinned ONNX token-reference gate and the per-model B/R/L/G matcher P/R gates mandatory. The recorded real-scene timing is not a LoMa speedup claim; make any speed claim only from a controlled same-hardware A/B.

capabilities.name: freeimage_to_openimageio
capabilities.validation: reconstruction_oiio_parity_gate (bitmap_test, undistortion_test, texture_mapping_test); PostInstall resolved OIIO runtime-closure check for ACloudViewer/CloudViewer/Colmap; installer payload closure checks on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows; stale-FreeImage source audit
capabilities.reason: The Reconstruction Bitmap ABI no longer exposes FreeImage and is backed by one pinned OpenImageIO 3.1.17.0 source ExternalProject on Linux, macOS, and Windows. Its required image/color closure is built when the host is too old, while local TIFF is always built from its upstream-pinned source to avoid the macOS Mono.framework ABI hazard. USE_OPENCV=OFF prevents the system OIIO to system OpenCV 4.2 injection path. The focused parity target remains available for local investigation but is intentionally not executed by GitHub CI. PostInstall uses CMake's native runtime-dependency resolver to copy the source-built OIIO libraries and every non-system resolved dependency into each independently installable ACloudViewer, CloudViewer, and Colmap component; macOS then rewrites those dylibs to @rpath. Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows installer jobs assert the OIIO closure before any platform dependency search path is added. The source build and package path have not yet completed on every remote platform.
prerequisites: macOS and Windows source-build and package jobs
capabilities.resolution: Promote only after the pinned OIIO source build and final package payload have completed on each platform. Run the focused bitmap/EXIF/resize/undistortion/texture target as a local or dedicated validation job when changing the image backend.

capabilities.name: database_version_migration
capabilities.validation: reconstruction_db_migration_gate: rebuilt after the two-view revert; PostMigrateTables refuses newer schemas with std::runtime_error and migrates legacy-395 sentinels (identity qvec LE F03F prefix, zero tvec, zero F/E/H) to NULL; database_test green.
capabilities.reason: The upstream user_version migration machinery is ported into the concrete Database as Pre/PostMigrateTables: version-gated row migrations (identity/zero qvec-tvec and zero E/F/H sentinels to NULL, descriptors.type) run for legacy upstream databases and for the fork-legacy numbering 395; the fork-legacy rigs column migration is preserved; two_view_geometries gains the camera1/camera2 blob columns. Databases written by a newer schema are refused at open instead of being silently misread. The COLMAP engine version is decoupled from the CLOUDVIEWER package version so the schema number tracks the aligned upstream (4.3.0.dev0 -> 4030000).
capabilities.resolution: Bump COLMAP_DATABASE_SCHEMA_REVISION (not the upstream version) when new versioned migrations land (e.g. pose_priors with W7). Keep the fork's own tables (float_descriptors/rig_cameras/frame_images) outside upstream migrations. Parity gates must run ctest from ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/libs/Reconstruction where enable_testing() rooted the test tree.

capabilities.name: ba_backend_surface
capabilities.entrypoint: optim/bundle_adjustment.{h,cc}, controllers/incremental_mapper.{h,cc}, sfm/incremental_mapper.{h,cc}, pipelines/option_utils.cpp, util/option_manager.cc, ui/license_widget.{h,cc}, ui/reconstruction_options_widget.cc
capabilities.validation: optim/bundle_adjustment_test (TestCheckIfStopped cooperative-cancellation gate; full ColmapLib ctest suite green apart from pre-existing environment failures: polynomial numeric, DA3 model path, GPU SIFT count, gpu_mat Not Run)
capabilities.reason: The bundle adjustment backend surface now matches upstream: BundleAdjustmentOptions.backend (CERES/CASPAR) is authoritative with use_caspar as the CLI alias; mapper options gain ba_local_backend/ba_global_backend (default CERES, wired into Local/GlobalBundleAdjustment); check_if_stopped is honored through a Ceres iteration callback in both BundleAdjuster and RigBundleAdjuster (the self-built Ceres reports USER_FAILURE for callback SOLVER_ABORT, so the test asserts the behavioral contract instead of the enum). capabilities.resolution: Do not reintroduce PBA. When extending the backend surface (e.g. rig BA factors in W3), extend the caspar parity gate matrix in the same change. The ACloudViewer app link with the retired PBA define must be covered by the next CI run.

capabilities.name: synthetic_dataset
capabilities.entrypoint: scene/synthetic.{h,cc} (compiled into ColmapLib), scene/synthetic_test.cc, base/gps.{h,cc} ENU API, base/gps_test.cc (upstream geometry/gps_test.cc ENU subset), base/database pose_priors persistence (CreatePosePriorsTable + full prepared-statement set + corrected ReadPosePriorRow), base/database UpdateKeypoints/ExistsTwoViewGeometry/ReadTwoViewGeometries() map overload, base/frame.h NumDataIds/operator==, base/image.h non-const Points2D/operator==, base/rig.h operator==, base/reconstruction.h NumRegFrames, util/types.h ShouldSwapImagePair, util/eigen_matchers.h, util/testing.h CreateTestDir/CreateDirIfNotExists, math/random_eigen.h, math/union_find.h, util/hash_containers.h
capabilities.validation: scene/synthetic_test 18/18 gtest cases green (dataset synthesis with priors, exhaustive/chained/sparse matches, track length, determinism, noise, image rendering); base/gps_test green (upstream EllipsoidToENU/ECEFToENU/ENUToEllipsoid/ENUToECEF WGS84 cases at 1e-8/1e-5). Full build EXIT=0; ctest 78/79 with the single remaining failure unrelated to this work (see reason).
capabilities.reason: synthetic.{h,cc,test.cc} are enabled in the build after closing the W3-2a residuals. The port surfaced and fixed five fork defects: (1) Rig::SensorFromRig built its Rigid3d from Eigen's Vector4d quaternion constructor, which expects [x,y,z,w], while the fork qvec convention is [w,x,y,z] - non-identity sensor-from-rig poses were silently mis-rotated; (2) GPSTransform used GRS80's flattening for WGS84 and XYZToEll broke out of its iteration on latitude alone, both now upstream parity; (3) the W3-2a pose_priors persistence had no table creation and no prepared statements, and ReadPosePriorRow dropped data_id and swapped sensor_id/type; (4) Frame::AddImageId re-derived camera data ids from image ids, which duplicated corrupt data_t(CAMERA, image_id, image_id) entries whenever image_id != camera_id after the D8 DataId correction - Database::ReadFrame now reads frame_data first and falls back to frame_images only for legacy rows; (5) Image::SetPoints2D(points) did not recompute num_points3D_, leaving ComputeNumObservations/ComputeMeanTrackLength at stale values. Database gained the upstream ExistsTwoViewGeometry/UpdateKeypoints/ReadTwoViewGeometries() names (the legacy ExistsInlierMatches already queried two_view_geometries and shares its statement). The upstream AddFrame auto-registration of posed frames is represented by the image-level RegisterImage bookkeeping in SynthesizeDataset until W3-2b lands the frame-level model. One ctest failure remains and is unrelated to this work: the optim/bundle_adjustment_caspar_test split-intrinsics focal=0 pp=0 parity case fails with bit-identical rms values under both the old and new SensorFromRig/SetPoints2D code paths, its sources are identical to HEAD (libs/Reconstruction/src/optim has no working-tree diff), and the test file was last touched by the 2026-09-07 commits that postdate the D8 baseline verification, so it is tracked as a pre-existing baseline issue independent of W9.
capabilities.resolution: Keep synthetic_test and the gps ENU numeric gates mandatory for every reconstruction build. The upstream UTM subset of geometry/gps_test.cc stays deferred with the UTM API itself until W7 requires it. When W3-2b lands the frame-level registration model, replace the image-level RegisterImage bookkeeping in SynthesizeDataset with the upstream AddFrame auto-registration.
